description: Dataset for a Norwegian medium and low voltage power distribution system with industrial loads is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Susanne Sandell, Daniel Bjerkehagen (SINTEF Energy Research). This dataset describes a Norwegian industrial medium voltage (MV) and low voltage (LV) distribution grid with load time series. Coverage: national (NO); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
